item.tib: khrid gdams ye shes rang shar nyams su len thabs chu zla'i me long
item.coloph: ces dpal (dpa') bo bdun sgrub drag gcod kyis (kyi) lag len me longs (long) bdun skor du bkod pa la/ rtsa gsum sgrub pa'i lag len 'gyur med gser gyi me long / zhi rgyas lag len dri med shel gyi me long / dbang drag lag len 'od ldan dung gi me long / lam khyer gcod kyis (kyi) lag len 'phrul gyi me long / rgyun khyer nar ma'i lag len 'od ldan li yi me long / sbyin bsregs (sreg) zhi drag lag len snang ldan gyi me long / man ngag khrid kyis (kyi) lag len chu zla'i me long dang bdun ste (te/)khong bla gyer gnyis kyis bka' nan ma theg pa dang / stag gu gcod pa rnams (rnam) dag gtsug phud bcas kyis (kyi) lha reg gis bskul ba dang / 'brog lhun grub dbang ldan sogs kyis (bskral) bar brten nas/ thos chung gsang sngags grags pa'i ngag la smos bzhin drung yig shes rab tshul khrims kyis sug bris bgyis pa'o//
